sentences.text: The documents define EMI as the equated monthly instalment payable by the borrower towards interest and principal, or the equated monthly instalment specified in Schedule I.
The evidence gives an EMI amount of ₹21,696 for a different home loan with a sanctioned amount of ₹25,00,000, an interest rate of 8.50% per annum, and a tenor of 240 months.
